For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Kuaze tinan tolunulu nia hela iha Nazaré, halo tuir Maria no José, servisu hanesan karpinteiru, no boot ba iha matenek, iha isin no iha grasa iha Maromak no ema nia oin.

With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Ho paun lima no ikan rua nia fó-han ema barak, hateke ba lalehan, hato'o obrigadu no fahe paun, no sira halibur bote sanulu-resin-rua nakonu ho paun-rahun ne'ebé sobra.

Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Nia la'o iha Salomaun nia varanda iha tempu malirin, no dehan: «Ha'u-nia bibi sira rona ha'u-nia lian… Ha'u no Aman ita ida de'it.»
Nia fila ba fatin ne'ebé Joaun batiza uluk. Nia hanorin katak buat ne'ebé Maromak kesi hamutuk, ema keta haketak, no nia fó bensaun ba labarik sira: «Husik labarik ki'ik sira mai ha'u.»

As the council plots His death, He withd: Bainhira Konsellu Boot halo planu atu oho nia, nia subar ho nia dixípulu sira iha sidade ida besik rai-fuik naran Efraín.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Matan-delek Bartimeu hakilar: «Jesus, Daviid nia Oan, hakmatek ba ha'u!» no nia haree. Zakeu sa'e ai-sikómoru atu haree nia: «Ohin salvasaun tama ona iha uma ida-ne'e.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Loron neen molok Páskua, Maria kose nia ain ho mina-morin nardu ne'ebé folin-boot, no uma nakonu ho morin. Nia simu ida-ne'e hanesan unsaun ba nia hakoi.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Nia tama Jerusalém sa'e kuda-burru oan ida bainhira ema barak lolo hena no ai-sanak sira: «Hosana ba Daviid nia Oan! Bensaun ba ida ne'ebé mai iha Na'i nia naran!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Bainhira nia haree sidade, nia tanis ba sidade ne'e: «Se ó mós hatene ohin buat ne'ebé lori dame ba ó!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Nia fila meza sira, «Ha'u-nia uma sei naran uma-orasaun ba nasaun hotu», no hahí feto-faluk kiak ida ne'ebé fó nia osan-mean ki'ik rua ikus.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Tuur iha Foho Oliveira hateke ba Templu, nia ko'alia kona-ba Templu nia destruisaun no kona-ba nia mai iha glória: «Buat ne'ebé imi halo ba ha'u-nia maun-alin ki'ik liu ida, imi halo ba ha'u.»

On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Iha foho ida iha Galileia nia haruka Na'in Sanulu-resin-ida: «Entaun bá, halo nasaun hotu sai dixípulu, batiza sira iha Aman, no Oan, no Espíritu Santu nia naran… No haree, ha'u hamutuk ho imi loron-loron to'o mundu nia rohan.»

Scripture does not record the place. It: Eskritura la temi fatin. Hatudu iha rate ne'ebé Igreja Jerusalém nian selebra nia Asunsaun husi uluk kedas.

This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Misteriu ida-ne'e akontese iha lalehan; hatudu iha ne'e hamutuk ho nia Asunsaun.

By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Tuir tradisaun ne'ebé ema hadomi, Virjem Maria fó Rozáriu ba Santu Domingos iha Prouille, iha Fransa, iha séculu 13 nia hahú, atu ajuda nia iha nia haklaken hasoru Albijense sira-nia eru. Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Santu Papa Piu V, nia mós dominikanu, fó ba Rozáriu nia forma baibain ho misteriu sanulu-resin-lima, Ksolok, Terus no Glória, iha tinan 1569. Hafoin vitória Lepanto iha loron 7 fulan-outubru 1571, ne'ebé hetan bainhira mundu kristaun tomak reza Rozáriu, nia halo loron ne'e festa Maria Vitória nian, ohin loron memória Virjem Maria Rozáriu nian. Iha Lourdes no Fátima, Virjem rasik mai ho rozáriu no husu atu ema reza loron-loron.
